system: CometBFT state execution and recovery (V1 incremental, source 401753b)

findings.title: Unchanged, already-reached VoteExtensionsEnableHeight update is rejected — permanent chain halt
findings.scenario: U2 (re-sent unchanged enable height after it is reached); U7 (enable, then re-send)
findings.summary: The updated ConsensusParams.ValidateUpdate dropped the old 'unchanged value -> nil' short-cut, so an application update whose Abci sub-record repeats the current VoteExtensionsEnableHeight P is rejected by row 6 (upd <= h) once P <= h, although rows 3 and 9 still accept unchanged values. updateState runs after the FinalizeBlock response is durable; the error makes ApplyBlock fail, consensus/blocksync panic, and every restart replays the stored block through the real app and is rejected again, so the chain halts permanently. TLC counterexample: genesis VEH=1, block 1 returns the unchanged parameter set, UpdateStateRejectedVE (6 states). Reproduced on 401753b (instrumented and clean) by harness/repro_MC-1.sh; the exact-old 9dd6e50 control accepts the same input.
